OverviewPage.label: About
OverviewPage.title: Overview
OverviewPage.scopeDescription: MOBISEC {year} aims to publish high quality papers that are closely related to various theories and practical applications in Mobile Internet Security to highlight the state-of-art research. The conference welcomes papers which are related to emerging technologies and their impact on E-Business ecosystems, digital transformation, and the future of information systems.
OverviewPage.impactDescription: We expect that MOBISEC {year} will be a catalyst for further research and technology improvements related to this important subject, fostering collaboration between academia and industry in addressing the challenges and opportunities of the digital great transformation.
OverviewPage.ctaDescription: Download the complete Call for Papers document for detailed submission guidelines, topics of interest, and important deadlines.

AuthorInstructionPage.label: For Authors
AuthorInstructionPage.title: Author Instructions
AuthorInstructionPage.subtitle: Guidelines for preparing and submitting papers to MOBISEC {year}
AuthorInstructionPage.regularPaperDescription: Authors are invited to submit original papers. Submissions must not substantially overlap with work that any of the authors have published elsewhere, or that is simultaneously under review for another conference with proceedings. An accepted paper must be registered before the registration deadline and presented at the conference. Failure to register by the deadline will result in automatic withdrawal of the paper from the proceedings and the program.
AuthorInstructionPage.regularPaperFileFormat: PDF format prepared using one of the following templates:
AuthorInstructionPage.regularRequirementAnonymous: Anonymous submission: No author names, affiliations, acknowledgments, or obvious self-references
AuthorInstructionPage.regularRequirementPageLength: Page length: 5–20 pages in EasyChair style, excluding bibliography and appendices
AuthorInstructionPage.regularRequirementOriginal: Original work: Must not overlap with previously published work
AuthorInstructionPage.regularRequirementPdfFormat: PDF format: Using EasyChair LaTeX or Word template
AuthorInstructionPage.regularRequirementRegistration: Registration: At least one author must register and present the paper
AuthorInstructionPage.posterSubmissionFormat: The submission should be a single PDF document consisting of (i) the poster abstract and (ii) the poster draft.
AuthorInstructionPage.posterAbstractIntro: Poster abstract should provide sufficient details about your research showing that you have adequate information to fill a poster.
AuthorInstructionPage.posterAbstractRequirements: Poster abstract should meet the following requirements:
AuthorInstructionPage.posterAbstractPageLimit: No more than 2 pages, including references and figures
AuthorInstructionPage.posterAbstractFileFormat: File format: Same as Regular Paper (PDF via EasyChair LaTeX or Word template)
AuthorInstructionPage.posterDraftDescription: All submissions must also include a draft of the poster to receive feedback from the committee before the conference. Poster size should be 32×40 inches but can be scaled down to letter paper size.
AuthorInstructionPage.posterCopyrightNote: The accepted posters will not be formally published, and their copyright will be owned by their authors. Therefore, authors can present or publish any content of their poster in other conferences or journals. Moreover, we welcome the latest research outcomes that were introduced at other venues.
AuthorInstructionPage.posterTrackSelection: During submission, please select "MOBISEC {year} - Poster Track"

AuthorInstructionPage.ctaDescription: For further information about submissions, please contact the MOBISEC {year} cyber chair

AnnouncementPage.label: Announcement
AnnouncementPage.title: Awards Nomination
AnnouncementPage.subtitle: MOBISEC {year} invites nominations for awards recognizing outstanding contributions to research, service, and academic leadership within the field of Mobile Internet Security.
AnnouncementPage.submissionDescription: Nominations can be submitted directly through the MOBISEC online portal. Click the button below to access the portal.
AnnouncementPage.attendanceNote: All award recipients must register for and attend MOBISEC {year} at {venue}, {location} ({dates}) to receive recognition.
AnnouncementPage.ctaDescription: For questions about the nomination process, please contact the MOBISEC {year} cyber chair
AnnouncementPage.awardBestPaperDesc: All papers submitted to the conference, regardless of authorship, are eligible for the Best Paper Award. This includes work by students, academic faculty, industry professionals, and research practitioners. Papers will be evaluated for originality, scientific merit, and the significance of their contributions to the field. All qualified papers will be automatically considered—no separate nomination is necessary.
AnnouncementPage.awardBestStudentDesc: Papers are eligible for the Best Student Paper Award if a student is listed as the first author. The student must be enrolled in an academic institution at the time of paper submission. While faculty members and other researchers may be listed as co-authors, the student's contribution must be clearly predominant. All qualified papers will be automatically considered—no separate nomination is necessary.
AnnouncementPage.awardExemplaryLecturerDesc: This award honors a mid-career or senior scholar who has demonstrated outstanding contributions to both pioneering research and knowledge dissemination in e-business information systems. The recipient will possess a distinguished record of academic achievements and outreach that has significantly influenced the field and fostered professional development among peers and students. Self-nominations are not permitted.
AnnouncementPage.awardYoungResearcherDesc: This award is presented to a rising star in Mobile Internet Security who has demonstrated extraordinary promise through early-career research achievements. Nominees will have shown the potential for significant long-term impact with innovative work and academic engagement. Self-nominations are not permitted.
AnnouncementPage.awardPromisingGraduateDesc: This award recognizes a graduate student who has demonstrated exceptional research acumen, made meaningful contributions to the Mobile Internet Security academic community, and shows great promise for a future academic or professional career. Nominees are required to be current Master's or Ph.D. students. A letter of recommendation from the student's supervisor or advisor is mandatory.
AnnouncementPage.awardIndustryPioneerDesc: This award celebrates an individual or team from the industry sector who has successfully initiated and implemented groundbreaking industrial innovation within the Mobile Internet Security field. The recipient's work must demonstrate practical success, measurable impact, and significant advancement of industry standards or practices. Final award recipients are required to deliver a 5-minute presentation on their innovation achievements during the Industrial & Innovation Session.
AnnouncementPage.nominationReqSummary: Summary of major research achievements and contributions
AnnouncementPage.nominationReqTeaching: Record of teaching or relevant service accomplishments (where appropriate)
AnnouncementPage.nominationReqDocumentation: Supporting documentation for achievements (e.g., publication lists, awards, project reports)
AnnouncementPage.nominationReqLetter: [For Promising Graduate Student Award only] A Letter of Recommendation from the nominee's supervisor
AnnouncementPage.nominationReqSlides: [For Industry Pioneer Award only] A maximum of 5 slides showcasing the innovation achievements in the Mobile Internet Security
AnnouncementPage.nominationRequirementsIntro: Submission of nomination materials is required only for the Distinguished Lecturer, Young Researcher, Promising Graduate Student, and Industry Pioneer Awards. All accepted papers are considered automatically for the Best Paper Award and Best Student Paper Award; no separate application or nomination is needed.
